custom_fields.description: Bill every subscription of this customer that is due on the same day on one invoice.
custom_fields.label: Consolidate Subscription Invoices

custom_fields.description: Blank keeps stock ERPNext behaviour (each subscription bills from its own start date). Calendar anchors every subscription to calendar months / calendar years (Jan 1). Anniversary anchors every subscription to the month and day (yearly) or day of month (monthly) of the anchor date.
custom_fields.label: Subscription Billing Anchor

custom_fields.description: Billing periods end the day before this date's next occurrence. Only the month and day matter for yearly terms; only the day of month for monthly terms.
custom_fields.label: Subscription Billing Anchor Date

custom_fields.description: Blank follows each plan's own billing interval. Year bills monthly-priced plans once a year at 12 x monthly x (1 - Annual Discount Percentage).
custom_fields.label: Subscription Billing Interval
